explanation: The shards, called ostraka, gave English the word ostracism. The loser of the vote had to leave Athens for ten years, but kept his property and citizenship.

claims.text: In an Athenian ostracism vote, citizens scratched or painted names on pieces of broken pottery.
Ostracism votes were not cast on wax tablets, bronze discs or palm leaves.
The word ostracism comes from ostraka, the Greek name for the pottery shards used as ballots.
A man ostracized from Athens had to leave for ten years but kept his property and citizenship.
